about: The parity case catalog: each bullet of the parity case list (the cases both recorders run), the case-id prefixes that cover it in each language, and what every golden must contain. python/tests/gateway/parity/test_parity_catalog.py fails if a bullet has no case in a golden that can run it, if a required item is missing, or if a recorded case belongs to no bullet.

comparisons.about: The comparisons a label may name (python/tests/gateway/parity/labels.py, gateway-client/tests/parity/labels.mjs). A new recording is judged only against the baselines listed for it: Python against py-agentcc-1.0.0; a TypeScript client against ts-client-1.0.1 in the same module format (the 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 step is D-01, proven between the two fixed goldens); TypeScript integrations against ts-integrations-1.0.0 in the same format. A label whose new side is a golden compares two fixed goldens, so its --new must be that golden byte for byte.

twins.about: Areas whose rules hold in both languages (D-07 and D-14: key and base-URL resolution), so each language records the other's case ids. python/tests/gateway/parity/test_parity_twins.py compares the mode-stripped Python ids with every TypeScript client golden's ids under the prefix and fails on any id one side lacks, unless a language-only prefix below names it with its reason.
